cohort: 120 pregnant women with clinically suspected singleton IUGR at 34-40 weeks gestation in a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Among 120 clinically diagnosed IUGR cases, only three mothers (all vegetarians from rural backgrounds) had TSH levels below 0.3 mIU/L, with adverse delivery outcomes (one stillbirth, two low birth weight live births requiring caesarean section and NICU admission).
mod_finding: Two of the three mothers with low TSH levels delivered via caesarean section.
birth_weight: less than 1.5 kgs (for two of the three mothers with low TSH)
